summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces, without running tests or committing. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns False for non-URIRef operands and otherwise checks ref == uri over stored term URIs (node-type-aware, inherited by _RDFNamespace); _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). In test/test_namespace.py, added test_namespace_prefix_contains, test_rdfs_closed_contains, and test_rdf_closed_contains to NamespacePrefixTest, covering the positive, negative, direction, container-property, and non-URIRef cases from the spec. Tests and doctests have not been run.
